projects.name: BakeriQ
projects.tagline: A WhatsApp-first bakery order management platform, built end to end during my full-stack internship at Digital Mesh Softech.
bullets: FastAPI and PostgreSQL backend with Celery and Redis for background jobs
Two React/Vite front ends (owner dashboard and customer ordering app), all run in Docker Compose
A local Llama 3.2 model (via Ollama) turns free-text WhatsApp orders in English and Manglish into validated carts, at zero API cost
{tests} automated tests and {adrs} architecture decision records

projects.name: ScorpioWatch
projects.tagline: An event-driven automation engine: it watches files, matches glob triggers and runs your commands through the swatch CLI.
bullets: Commands run with no shell and an allow-listed environment; per-step timeouts stop the whole process group
100% test coverage with mypy --strict; releases ship through GitHub Actions and PyPI Trusted Publishing

projects.name: Nyxora
projects.tagline: An offline terminal password manager with a Textual TUI: Argon2id, XChaCha20-Poly1305 and per-entry HMAC integrity checks.
bullets: Cross-platform CI with secret scanning, dependency CVE checks and 8 required merge checks
A personal project; it has not been independently audited
